text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in CI with dry-run mode for a week, then enforce rules. It lets us test the tool’s impact without risking real PRs, proving its value first. The trade-off is slower feedback loops during dry-run, but that’s safer than breaking workflows. After a week, we enforce rules to lock in quality gains.

name: Gauge
text: Dry-run normalizes noise by letting PR-Agent’s edits sit unchecked in PRs, so the "safe" test actually trains the team to ignore its output—until we enforce it and break workflows anyway. Instead, run PR-Agent in CI with a *read-only* mode that logs violations but never edits; after two weeks, if the logs show clear, actionable patterns, we enforce the rules. Settle it by requiring the lead to state the decision and attach the violation log showing at least 3 distinct, fixable issues.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in CI with a *read-only* mode for one week, then enforce rules on a single non-blocking PR per day for two weeks—this cuts the dry-run noise while still proving value faster than a full dry-run week. The trade-off is slightly higher risk during enforcement, but the shorter read-only phase reduces wasted time training the team to ignore the tool.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in CI with *read-only* mode for one week, then enforce rules on a single non-blocking PR per day for two weeks. This balances safety with speed—read-only proves the tool’s value without training the team to ignore it, while the short enforcement phase limits risk. The trade-off is accepting slightly higher noise in PRs during enforcement, but the faster feedback loop outweighs the dry-run’s slower pace. After three weeks, we’ll lock in enforcement if the data shows real quality gains.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in CI with *read-only* mode for one week, then enforce rules on one non-blocking PR daily for two weeks—start with the lowest-risk PRs to validate impact before scaling.

Result: A proven PR-Agent integration with measured team adoption and no workflow disruptions. Owner: Overhaul.
